content_text:
Manhattan Active SCALE Documentation
        Shipping Container Web Service
    
    
         
                Collapse All
                Expand All
            
        View with Navigation Tools
    
    
    
    
    
        The Shipping Container Web Service allows access to a Shipping Container in the application.


     Request



    
        URI: http://ServerName/outbound/ShippingContainers?warehouse={warehouse}&containerId={containerId}

        Method: GET

        Accept: application/json or application/xml

        Roles: SCALEUSER,Confidential
    



     Response



    Aside from standard responses, note the following specifics for this service:

    

    
        
            
                Status Code

                Notes
            

            
                200

                
                    OK will be accompanied by an entity conforming to one of the requested media types: application/vnd.manh.ils.shipping.shippingContainer+json, XML

                    Links available:-

                    

                    
                        
                            
                                rel

                                Media type(s)
                            

                            
                                self

                                application/vnd.manh.ils.shipping.shippingContainer+json, XML
                            

                            
                                qcCounts

                                application/vnd.manh.ils.shipping.shippingContainerQcCounts+json, XML 
                            

                            
                                nestShippingContainerOnMultiOrderPalletUri

                                
                                    application/vnd.manh.ils.shipping.multiOrderPallet+json, XML
                                
                            

                            
                                unNestShippingContainerOnMultiOrderPalletUri

                                
                                    application/vnd.manh.ils.shipping.multiOrderPallet+json, XML
                                
                            
                        
                    

                    
                
            

            
                400

                The following ErrorTypes can be expected: Container, Warehouse
